name: Boids
author: E. T. Carter
description: A murmuration streaming across the whole frame at dusk: hundreds of small swept-wing marks banking together, piling into dense clumps and thinning to open gaps as turning waves roll through the flock. Each bird flaps on its own clock and drags a fading motion trail, with three parallax depths from small fogged distant birds to large bright near ones.

params.label: Flight speed
params.effect: Speed of the whole swarm and of everything inside it; 0 freezes the flock mid-turn.

params.label: Flock density
params.effect: How much of the sky the flock fills; low is a few scattered clumps, high is a near-solid murmuration.

params.label: Trail length
params.effect: Length of the motion streak behind each bird; 0 is crisp single marks.

params.label: Bird size
params.effect: Size of every bird against its slot; small is a dust of distant specks, large is a close pass.

params.label: Turning waves
params.effect: Strength of the coherent banking waves that roll through the flock; 0 is a steady stream.
